prompt:
A Binary Search Tree (BST) is constructed by sequentially inserting the following keys into an initially empty tree:
`[155, 105, 205, 80, 130, 180, 230]`

What is the exact **Postorder** traversal sequence of this tree?
explanation: Postorder traversal visits Left Subtree -> Right Subtree -> Root. Root 155 is processed last after all its children: [80, 130, 105, 180, 230, 205, 155].
